widget.name: Loading Canvas
widget.description: Interactive packing canvas for truck loading planning. Supports pallet and box positioning, 90° rotation, grid snapping, real-time validation, and loading/saving packing plans.

property.caption: Truck Selection
property.description: The TruckSelection datasource from page parameters or microflow

property.caption: Transport Orders
property.description: List of TransportOrder objects to display as cargo items

property.caption: Session
property.description: The Session datasource from page parameters

property.caption: Canvas Width (px)
property.description: Width of the canvas in pixels

property.caption: Canvas Height (px)
property.description: Height of the canvas in pixels

property.caption: On Save Plan
property.description: Action triggered when the user saves the packing plan

property.caption: On Load Plan
property.description: Action triggered when the widget loads the packing plan
